context: Sho tells Grandma about a funny, sad day.
purpose: Casual home register; vocabulary (涙/笑い/弱い/面倒/気づい) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、今日転んで泣いちゃった。
lines.en: Grandma, I fell and cried today.
lines.style: pouty small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: あら、涙が出たのね。痛かった?
lines.en: Oh, you shed tears. Did it hurt?
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm gentle delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: でも、友達の笑い話で元気出たよ。
lines.en: But my friend's funny story cheered me up.
lines.style: brightening small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 泣くのは、弱いことじゃないのよ。
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 片付けが、面倒だったんだもん。
lines.en: Cleaning up was such a hassle.
lines.style: whiny small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 面倒でも、やり遂げたのね。えらいわ。
lines.en: Even if it was a hassle, you finished. Good boy.
lines.style: gentle grandmother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 笑ったら、涙が乾いたって気づいた!
lines.en: When I laughed, I noticed my tears dried!
lines.style: happy small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 良いことに、気づいたわね。
lines.style: tender grandmother voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
